localFilePath.description:
Path for the .py file where the source code is located.

If not specified in #toolAttributes, we will assume the name of the tool is the file name after trimming the extension and
path. E.g. 'local/file/path/tool_name.py', will assume 'tool_name' as the tool's name.

toolAttributes.description:
Any {@link Genai.Agent.Dynamic.Tool} attributes that we want to define during object creation.
E.g. {@link Genai.Agent.Dynamic.Tool#description}. These arguments can be used when we want to specify attributes beyond
the defaults.

title: Spec used to define a {@link Genai.Agent.Dynamic.Tool} from a local file.
name: Genai.Agent.Dynamic.Tool.FromLocalFileSpec
